# MDL402 · `boolean-flag-value`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

An option that takes no value is given one that looks like `false`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | options |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | unsafe |
| Design references | G1, G2, G12 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`mdl402-routines-zero-dumps-routines`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl402-routines-zero-dumps-routines.txtar), [`mdl402-no-data-zero-skips-data`](../../e2e/scenarios/mdl402-no-data-zero-skips-data.txtar) |

## Why

Options such as `routines` or `no-data` take no value: mydumper passes `--routines 0`, GLib sets the option and leaves `0` aside. `routines=0`, `routines=false` and `routines=off` therefore all ENABLE routines. Options flagged reverse behave the same way: their presence applies them, whatever the value.

To disable an option, remove the line (the fix comments it out). Values such as `true` or `yes` are harmless but misleading (info); any other value is ignored too (warning).

## Example

With mydumper v0.19.3-3:

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
routines=0
triggers=false
  events=OFF
```

```text
2:10-2:11 error MDL402[boolean-flag-value] `routines=0` turns routines on: the option takes no value, so GLib ignores `0`
  = routines takes effect, the opposite of what `0` says.
  fix (unsafe): Comment the line out to leave the option off
3:10-3:15 error MDL402[boolean-flag-value] `triggers=false` turns triggers on: the option takes no value, so GLib ignores `false`
  = triggers takes effect, the opposite of what `false` says.
  fix (unsafe): Comment the line out to leave the option off
4:10-4:13 error MDL402[boolean-flag-value] `events=OFF` turns events on: the option takes no value, so GLib ignores `OFF`
  = events takes effect, the opposite of what `OFF` says.
  fix (unsafe): Comment the line out to leave the option off
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix --unsafe-fixes`:

```ini
[mydumper]
#routines=0
#triggers=false
  #events=OFF
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL402: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL402` on the line above it.
